<svg viewBox="0 0 240 165" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="236" height="161" rx="8" fill="#FAFBFD" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="120" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E293B">ĐỊNH LÍ VIÈTE: x² – 5x + 6 = 0 (x₁=2, x₂=3)</text>
  <line x1="24" y1="108" x2="216" y2="108" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="142" x2="52" y2="28" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Parabola passing through (2,0) at x=108 and (3,0) at x=136, vertex (2.5,-0.25) at (122, 118) -->
  <path d="M 76,34 Q 122,188 168,34" fill="none" stroke="#2563EB" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  <circle cx="106" cy="108" r="3.8" fill="#DC2626"/>
  <circle cx="138" cy="108" r="3.8" fill="#DC2626"/>
  <text x="100" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#DC2626">x₁=2</text>
  <text x="144" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#DC2626">x₂=3</text>
  <rect x="20" y="130" width="200" height="26" rx="4" fill="#FEF3C7" stroke="#D97706"/>
  <text x="120" y="147" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#92400E">S = x₁+x₂ = –b/a = 5  |  P = x₁x₂ = c/a = 6</text>
</svg>

  <text x="155" y="96" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#DC2626">M(2 ; 1)</text>
  <text x="135" y="42" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563EB">2x + y = 5</text>
  <text x="172" y="64" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#EA580C">x – y = 1</text>

diagrams.S_G07_B25_diagram.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 240 165" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="236" height="161" rx="8" fill="#FAFBFD" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="120" y="19" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E293B">THU GỌN & CỘNG ĐA THỨC CÙNG BẬC</text>
  <rect x="16" y="30" width="208" height="34" rx="5" fill="#EFF6FF" stroke="#3B82F6"/>
  <text x="120" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#1D4ED8">P(x) =  3x³   –   2x²   +   5x   –   4</text>
  <text x="120" y="59" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#047857">Q(x) = –3x³   +   4x²   –   x    +   6</text>
  <line x1="26" y1="70" x2="214" y2="70" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="78" width="208" height="32" rx="5" fill="#FEF9C3" stroke="#CA8A04"/>
  <text x="120" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#991B1B">P(x)+Q(x) = 0x³ + 2x² + 4x + 2 = 2x² + 4x + 2</text>
  <text x="120" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E293B">• Bậc của tổng là 2 (vì 3x³ + (–3x³) = 0 đã triệt tiêu!)</text>
  <text x="120" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8.5" fill="#475569">• Hệ số cao nhất: 2   |   Hệ số tự do: 2</text>
</svg>
